_meta.description: BROski Brain Ops — canonical error codes and status taxonomy

DEGRADED.meaning: Some containers up, some APIs slow (>2s)

UNHEALTHY.meaning: Core container down or all APIs timeout

HC_004.message: Port 8100 in use by another process

health_check.note: ONLY operation that halts the full chain. If Docker/API is down, nothing else can run.

FULL.meaning: All repos synced, all issues pulled

PARTIAL.meaning: Some repos synced, rate limit hit or timeout

FAILED.meaning: No repos synced, token invalid or network down

GH_002.action: Wait 1h, or upgrade to higher tier

GH_003.message: Repo does not exist or no access
GH_003.action: Check GITHUB_REPOS env var, verify PAT scopes

github_sync.note: Partial sync is acceptable — briefing generates with whatever was pulled.

GENERATED.meaning: Briefing .md created and written to vault

PARTIAL.meaning: Briefing created but some sections missing (API timeouts)

FAILED.meaning: Could not generate briefing, vault path invalid or API down

BR_001.message: Vault path does not exist or not writable

BR_002.action: Check hyper-brain logs: docker logs hyper-brain

BR_003.action: Verify briefing template exists in configs/

briefing_generation.note: If FAILED, vault commit still runs (no files to commit, will be NO_CHANGES).

COMMITTED.meaning: Changes committed to git with message

NO_CHANGES.meaning: No new files, git diff empty

VC_001.message: Git not initialized in vault folder

VC_002.action: git config user.name 'BROski' && git config user.email 'broski@hyperfocus.zone'

vault_commit.note: Commit failure should NOT block Discord report — vault issue ≠ ops failure.

DC_002.action: Verify webhook still exists, check channel permissions

discord_report.note: Last step. Discord fail = report missed, vault is still truth.
